source: CT2Yarn (github.com/netbeifeng/ct2yarn, MIT, Luo & Umetani PG2026), applications/assets/stitch_templates/
units: points_normalised: divided by estimated yarn diameter d=37 voxels (measured as min non-local centreline self-distance, consistent across all 3 templates); origin at curve centroid; axes = PCA principal axes (longest, second, shortest). points_voxels: raw micro-CT voxel coords as shipped.
caveat: No mm-per-voxel scale is published in the CT2Yarn paper or repo. Sample yarn is for a 3.0-4.0 mm hook.
resampling: uniform 2.0 voxels = 0.054 d between consecutive points
